# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Database / Prisma
- [ ] UI / UX

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run qa`
- [ ] `npm run prisma:seed`
- [ ] Prisma migration added if schema changed
- [ ] Manual test completed

## Tenant and Permission Safety

- [ ] Queries are filtered by `companyId` where required
- [ ] Protected routes use permissions
- [ ] No cross-company data access introduced
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or sensitive data in logs

## Screenshots

Add screenshots for UI changes.

## Notes

Add deployment, migration or follow-up notes.
